senses.gloss: बृब॑द्-उक्थ m. N. of Indra, RV. viii, 32, 50 (either महद्-उक्थ, ‘highly lauded’, or वक्तव्यम् अस्मा उक्थम्, ‘one to whom praise is to be ascribed’, Nir. vi, 4).
बृबु॑ m. N. of a man (according to Sāy. ‘the carpenter of the Paṇis’), RV. vi, 45, 31; Mn. x, 107.
बृबूक n. water, RV. x, 27, 33 (cf. Naigh. i, 12; others ‘mfn. dense, thick’).
